reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The built-in WireGuard userspace-mode fallback (Helm `wireguard.userspaceFallback`) has been deprecated and will be removed in a future version of Cilium", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: deprecation

consequence.statement: The wireguard.userspaceFallback setting is deprecated and will be removed in a future release; users relying on WireGuard userspace-mode fallback must migrate to using Linux kernel WireGuard support.
consequence.remediation: Ensure your Linux kernel has native WireGuard support enabled and remove or disable the wireguard.userspaceFallback helm value in your Cilium configuration.

proposed.statement: The Helm value wireguard.userspaceFallback is deprecated and will be removed in a future version of Cilium; users must have Linux kernel WireGuard support.
